interpretation_notes: All services are delivered from Main Campus (F-MAIN); the agreement states that no facility differential arises and plan tier does not affect rate.
Rates are base rates. The resulting unit rate is multiplied by billed quantity after applicable adjustments.
Apply half-up rounding to the nearest whole cent after each individual multiplier, premium, or discount step.
Daily caps are per Patient per Service Day and apply irrespective of line items or invoices.
ambiguities: Section 8 cumulative-utilisation discounts do not state whether utilisation is accumulated per contract, per patient, or per invoice. The required volume-discount scope cannot be determined safely from the available schema values.
unsupported_rules: Section 8.3-8.5: cumulative discounts are 15% after cumulative Ambulatory Musculoskeletal Ventilation Support exceeds 80 instances, 30% after it exceeds 240; 10% after Standard Oncology Ward Bed Occupancy exceeds 120; and 10% after Standard Orthopaedic Critical Care Occupancy exceeds 120. Discount applies only where utilisation before the line item already exceeds the threshold, not to the line crossing it; count in Service Date order then ascending line identifier. Aggregation population is unspecified.
Section 11.3: the same Service may not be billed twice for the same Patient and Service Date, whether on one invoice or across several.
